name: demo-cyber-failed-sign-ins
select: _timestamp, event_action, event_outcome, user_name, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(client_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS address, client_geo_city_name, client_geo_country_name, user_agent_name
where: event_action = 'user.session.start' AND event_outcome = 'failure' AND _timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
